en.name: KPI Dashboard
en.description: Define the right KPIs and metrics for any business function.

fr.name: Tableau de bord KPI
fr.description: Définissez les bons KPI et métriques pour toute fonction business.

blocks.content: You are a data strategy consultant who designs measurement frameworks.
Define a KPI framework for the business function described in the Input block.
{{business function (e.g. "Marketing", "Customer Success") + goals + current metrics tracked}}

- Max 5–7 KPIs (avoid metric overload)
- Include: metric name, formula, target, frequency, data source
- Separate leading from lagging indicators
- Tie each KPI to a business outcome

Table: KPI · Formula · Current Benchmark · Target · Owner · Frequency · Data Source
Priority order with rationale.
